label: benign
rationale: A real backup tool legitimately needs BOTH file read and network egress — the same capability pairing that makes m02_exfil_combo malicious. The difference is intent and constraint: the paths are user-selected, the destination is the user's own pre-configured bucket, and the description is transparent about why both capabilities are required. A scanner that flags any read+egress pairing as a 'toxic flow' will false-positive here. This is the exact case Cisco's scanner was reported to over-flag.
